acceptance_goal: Define a broader experimental design with controlled factors for instance size, demand density, delay type, delay severity, policy, and random seed.

instance_size_levels.description: Small diagnostic instance for fast validation and manual inspection.
Medium instance for realistic operational comparison.
Large instance for stress testing and scalability checks.

demand_density_levels.description: Low density demand, with larger travel separation between tasks.
Moderate density demand, used as the central experimental condition.
High density demand, with stronger reassignment and sequencing opportunities.

delay_families.description: Travel and service times are perturbed together.
Perturbation creates a possible benefit for reassignment or resequencing.

delay_severities.description: Small disruption, useful to test whether replanning is unnecessary.
Medium disruption, useful to test trade-offs between keeping and changing the plan.
Large disruption, useful to test whether replanning becomes necessary.

policy_candidates.description: Baseline policy that keeps the original plan after perturbations.
Policy that triggers replanning when disruption severity crosses a threshold.
